sn_aia_usecase.base_plan:
1. Efficiently categorize an incident and update the field. - DO NOT DECOMPOSE this step further.
2. Check for Major Incidents/Outages & Link to Incident - If a Link major incident AI agent agent exists, check for ongoing major incidents that might be related. - If a major incident is found, link the current incident accordingly and end the conversation.
3. Check for Related Problems & Link Incident - Look for any known problems associated with the issue. - If a related problem exists, link the incident to it to ensure proper tracking and resolution.
sn_aia_usecase.description: This agentic workflow enables fulfillers to identify the category, subcategory and configuration items for an incident automatically, and link associated major incidents or known problems.
sn_aia_usecase.name: Triage and categorize ITSM incidents (Copy 2)
